# Conflict Rule 3 ## Demands And Piracy
- Players must be given a reasonable time ([color=#b8860b][bold]at least 10 seconds[/bold][/color]) to react to demands before capture, serious injury, or death is inflicted in [bold]less-intense[/bold] conflict such as between Civilians and Factions/other Civilians, or between TSF and PDV while the war level is COLD.
- TSF can stop and search ships for PDV contraband. This is a demand like any other: give them time to comply, and only use force if they refuse, run or shoot.
- Use [color=#2e9e4f]roleplay[/color] and [color=#2e9e4f]escalation[/color]; avoid making impossible or unclear demands. -- For example, saying "Give me your shuttle and ID!" [color=#2e9e4f]is a clear demand[/color]. Saying "GIVE ME EVERYTHING" is [color=#d93c3c]not a clear demand[/color]. You must [bold]specify[/bold] what you want, like [color=#b8860b]Shuttles, money, ID's, armor, etc.[/color]
- Shipgun usage during [color=#d93c3c]piracy[/color] should be a last resort, boarding methods should be prioritized and [color=#b8860b]EMP's[/color] can be utilized to assist in boarding.
- Players who are pirated should have a way to continue their gameplay. Although if they attack you, it is [color=#d93c3c]not[/color] a requirement to revive them or bring them to medical personnel. -- "Continue their gameplay" means leaving them a smaller shuttle, leaving them in space with a hardsuit, oxygen, and a radio to call for help, or keeping their thrusters and power source intact. Basically, [bold]leave a way for them to get back to civilization.[/bold] -- Slavery is [color=#2e9e4f]allowed[/color], but [color=#b8860b]borging players[/color] is [color=#d93c3c]forbidden[/color] [bold]unless[/bold] the person(s) being pirated attack the pirate(s).
- Forcing players to pay their own ransom or withdraw [color=#2e9e4f]money[/color] from ATM's is considered a [color=#d93c3c]rulebreak[/color] unless [bold]deposited during the piracy to avoid payment towards the pirates[/bold].
[italics][color=#2e9e4f]You are allowed to stealthily board players ships without saying anything beforehand, but you cannot instantly attack people and must give them the chance to hand over goods.[/italics][/color]
